title: Metabolic Reprogramming via ACOD1 depletion enhances function of human induced pluripotent stem cell-derived CAR-macrophages in solid tumors
model: Cas9 THP-1-derived macrophages, human metabolic-gene knockout library (~2,980 genes), CD80 FACS sort
contrast: CD80-high vs CD80-low macrophages, LPS+IFN-gamma (1 vs 1, no replicates)
paper_method: sgRNA enrichment ranking per bin (Supplementary Fig. 1f; no gene-level table)
paper_calls: Top-20 enriched genes per bin: KEAP1, NDUFS6, MPST, respiratory-chain/ROS genes lowering CD80; B3GNT8, ST3GAL6, NANS raising it; NFKB1 validated
barcs_calls: 0 genes at FDR 0.10 (screening-level, one library per bin, overdispersion inflation 510)
named_hits: Directions all correct (KEAP1, NFKB1, NDUFS6 depleted in CD80-high; B3GNT8, NANS, ST3GAL6 enriched) but none significant; KEAP1 #960, NFKB1 #1504 of 2,966
verdict: BARCS recovers the correct direction for every named gene but, with one library per bin and very high overdispersion, calls nothing at FDR 0.10 where the paper ranked sgRNAs; the reanalysis is screening-level only.
